summary: RemSleep Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of its independent auditor, Fruci Associates II, PLLC, effective July 17, 2026, on amicable terms with no disagreements. The company is engaging a successor PCAOB-registered auditor. Additionally, following a Q2 2026 change in control and management transition, current management identified accounting and recordkeeping issues related to recognition, classification, and timing of liabilities and payments. The company plans an additional review of Q2 financial information with its new auditor, which may lead to restatements. Watch for the appointment of the successor auditor and any restatement announcements that could affect financial disclosures and investor confidence.
